title: Every blend mode
text: Every blend mode on a foreground inside a LAYER, over a grey ramp and coloured squares and hanging over the stage ground: a live cell (the renderer's blend path), a cell drawn by BitmapData.draw of the same layer, and a cell where the mode is on a container of two overlapping children. The foreground is a bitmap, and in the variants vector paths, drawRect fills, and discs with anti-aliased rims (the rims are scored apart, since each rasteriser anti-aliases in its own way).
